mostWorthwhile.text: Adding inhaled particles to the lining and then moving the mucus made the defense easy to follow: mucus traps some material and cilia carry it toward the throat.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the moving lining to the body felt like an assembly step without much new explanation, although it placed the defense in the whole body.

surprise.text: Some microbes continued toward the air sacs despite the mucus, giving the macrophages a distinct role.

arbitrary.text: I did not expect the lining to need connecting to the body before adding macrophages. The compatibility feedback resolved the step, but the required order was not clear to me.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter if it explored a new relationship as clearly as the mucus and macrophage defenses, though repeated assembly steps could become less engaging.
